description: Reports who the caller currently is: an authenticated account, an anonymous draft holder, or nobody. Never errors on absent credentials. You do not need to call this before building - building needs no identity at all.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

name: whoami
title: Who am I
